caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, cream-colored piece of fabric with embroidered decorations. The border of the fabric features an interlocking loop pattern stitched in blue thread, running continuously around all four sides, with a scalloped red outline along the very edge. Inside the border, the central composition consists of a symmetrical arrangement of stylized flowers, leaves, and stems rendered in fine lines. The floral motifs are stitched using various thread colors, including red, pink, blue, yellow, green, and black. The design is organized around an axis, with curved branches extending from a central stem at the bottom center, creating an arch-like, fan-shaped pattern. Additional decorative arcs in yellow and blue thread radiate outward from the lower central stem, while small flower clusters emerge along these lines. The fabric appears lightly textured and the embroidery stitches are delicate, filling the central area but leaving substantial open space around the motifs.
title: Embroidered Blanket
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
